```python
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username=username, password=password)
release_by_song_id = {}
page = 0
while True:
    songs = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page)
    if not songs:
        break
    for s in songs:
        detail = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=s.song_id)
        release_by_song_id[s.song_id] = detail.release_date
    page += 1
# Repeat pagination for albums and playlists, then:
target = min(release_by_song_id, key=release_by_song_id.get)  # or max for newest
answer = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=target).title
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=answer, status="success")
```
